semanticCoverage.food-1-014-extension-01: Dressing sequence, mirror fit checks, example scope, workplace-specific clothing and changing places; no unauthorized removal or rolled sleeves.
semanticCoverage.food-1-015-extension-01: 2026 example with approximate 30/20 seconds, paper OR air drying, alcohol afterwards, no skipped stages and workplace procedure.
semanticCoverage.food-1-029-extension-01: Ten PPE types and uses; no hot liquid through the glove opening; no universal protection or hand insertion into moving machinery.
semanticCoverage.food-1-035-extension-01: Close-load, knee, hip and slow-standing sequence; no guarantee for any weight; trolley, assistance and staffing checks.
semanticCoverage.food-1-024-extension-01: Legal versus voluntary tests; viable bacterial count, E. coli and coliform distinctions; optional named organisms; no uniform list for every food.
semanticCoverage.food-1-042-extension-01: Sign differences for slips, falls, trapping and rotating hazards; PPE, exit and extinguisher location checks; multiple designs.
semanticCoverage.food-1-033-extension-01: KYT hidden hazards; people versus objects; paired reasons and actions; no actual recreation of dangerous scenarios.
semanticCoverage.food-1-037-extension-01: Eleven languages, eight cases each, three viewing headings, external access and updates, no automatic equipment transfer or unauthorized copying.
semanticCoverage.food-2-009-extension-01: Version 2 to approved 3 versus unapproved 4; preparation and revision dates, drafter and approver, version traceability.
semanticCoverage.food-2-010-extension-01: K2/T7 fictional 4.0–8.0℃; planned versus actual time; A as recorder and B as reviewer; chronological uncertainty; no clearance solely from temperature recovery.
semanticCoverage.food-2-012-extension-01: All lettered routes and bypasses; verified H as assumed CCP; no heating or cooling conditions; returning tools and general hygiene still matter.
semanticCoverage.food-2-013-extension-01: CL and OL remain distinct; temperature AND time and inclusive minima; A meets both, B only CL, C fails CL temperature; no compensation by time or reuse for new products.
semanticCoverage.food-2-020-extension-01: Random population eligibility and selected bags; no guarantee; stable normal-distribution assumptions, all sigma ranges and percentages; not specifications.
semanticCoverage.food-2-021-extension-01: Inclusive lower and exclusive upper class limits; frequencies 4/3/3; six shapes are clues, not confirmed causes.
semanticCoverage.food-2-021-extension-02: All A–F series; UCL/LCL versus product acceptance; hypothetical graph rules are not workplace criteria; no cause inferred from chart alone.
semanticCoverage.food-2-021-extension-03: All record counts and Pareto cumulative percentages; axes, radar comparability, band/radar answer data and unconfirmed cause branches.
semanticCoverage.food-2-027-extension-01: Time-weighted output and rates, all assumptions, rounding final percentages only from second to first decimal; no hidden safety stops.
semanticCoverage.food-2-028-extension-01: Company-specific V deductions, not universal accounting; elapsed hours versus person-hours, five unit results; do not cut safety or staffing for numbers.
semanticCoverage.food-2-033-extension-01: Fictional nonmultiplicative risk matrix, all rows and responses; required legal and imminent-danger action; hierarchy and residual hazards.
semanticCoverage.food-2-016-extension-01: ISO9001 quality, ISO14001 environment, ISO22000 food safety; FSSC scheme, prerequisites and extra requirements; SQF/JFS-C scope; no automatic legal or product assurance.

coverageStatement: Read all 20 titles, all 20 texts and all 12 substantive answers in each locale against the source; mechanically checked all 60 fields per locale, including 8 empty answers.

advisories.sourceSense: 未処理の物 in food-processing context
advisories.beforeFragment: မကုသရသေးသောပစ္စည်း
advisories.suggestedFragment: မပြုပြင်ရသေးသောပစ္စည်း
advisories.rationale: Current wording literally means untreated items and preserves the contamination warning, but ကုသ can sound medical. A food-processing-specific synonym could improve wording; this is not a confirmed factual or safety-logic defect.
advisories.resolution: Root applied exactly the suggested single replacement; independently accepted as food-processing-specific wording for 未処理.

limitations: This is AI peer review, not native-speaker or domain certification.
No new external legal/ISO claims were verified; translations retain the source-bound and current-information caveats.
Only confirmed Myanmar/Khmer terminology inventory is authoritative; 2号-only terms absent from the supplied 1号 books remain context-reviewed rather than textbook-certified.
Unicode inspection and reading found no propagated corrupt text-layer glyphs; a current visual/font rendering check remains separate.
